load_hdf5_trajectory: create an HDF5TrajectoryLoader to load mocap trajectories from an HDF5 file by path
get_trajectory_by_key: use TrajectoryLoader get_trajectory to retrieve a trajectory by key with optional time and step bounds
limit_prop_mass: create a PropMassLimiter to cap the maximum mass of each prop in a trajectory proto
resize_props: create a PropResizer to scale or adjust prop sizes and mass in a trajectory proto
offset_z_positions: create a ZOffsetter to shift the z position of walkers and props in a trajectory proto
